instruction.text: You begin looking towards a light blue wall, kind of? Turn to the left and jump over the little white chair, just to the side of you, towards the sitting area. Once you've jumped over that chair, turn slightly right and move to the open double doors. Step out of those open double doors into the middle of the hallway, and turn right. Move down the hallway until the next left hand turn. Step into the bedroom in front of the elliptical machine, and then turn around to the right and you should see a laundry room across the hallway. Move into that laundry room, and once you're standing in front of the dryer, you're done.
